name: Festering Goblin — the dies trigger's picker leaves out the card that died
notes: "When this creature dies, target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn." The card is in the graveyard when the trigger is put on the stack, so it cannot be a target; the picker listed Festering Goblin itself. A condition with another event ("enters or dies", "this creature or another creature you control dies") still lists the card.
